desc: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo P up to N.
Implement DP with state (a, p, e, v) where a=last layer size, p=parity of layers processed, e=even vertex count, v=total vertices. Use dictionary of lists for polynomials in y (non-tree edge count).
Transition: for b in 1..N-1-v, update state, compute delta and weight, shift polynomial and accumulate.
After DP, for v=N-1 and e=N/2, sum polynomials over all a and p. Multiply by (N-1)! and map to M = N-1 + e.
Output answers for M = N-1 to N(N-1)/2, separated by spaces.
